Select drug ChEMBL ID, preferred name, MeSH ID, MeSH heading, EFO ID as indication_curie, EFO term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind from drug_indication joined to molecule_dictionary on molregno. Filter for drugs with max_phase = 4 and indications with max_phase_for_ind = 1. Sort by drug ChEMBL ID, preferred name, MeSH ID, MeSH heading, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
